item.text: I’m checking the reconstructed filing JSON and will pull the registrant name directly from the document text, then return only the required one-line answer.
`rg` isn’t available in this environment, so I’m switching to a direct parse of the JSON and searching the filing text for the registrant header.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, re
path='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/AMAZON_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(path) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data.get('texts',[])
patterns=['registrant','Amazon.com, Inc.','exact name','name of registrant']
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    text=t.get('text','')
    low=text.lower()
    if any(p.lower() in low for p in patterns):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',repr(text[:500]))
PY"
